title: Guitarist Mei Nekozuki Dies
content: There will be refunds offered for her originally scheduled live events, including her birthday solo live concert on July 29, which have been canceled. Nekozuki was active as a BanG Dream! support guitarist for the millsage and Ikka DumbRock! bands, and she was also active in the C2 Kikan 1MYB band for Kan Colle .
author: ANN

title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms Sudden Delay for Next New Episode
content: A major Isekai franchise now streaming with Crunchyroll has confirmed a sudden delay before the release of its next new episode this season. Isekai has had a great year of new anime releases so far, and that naturally includes all of the blockbuster franchises that made their return for new episodes as well.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll to Stream Romelia War Chronicle Anime
content: This year's Otakon event will screen the world premiere on July 31 at 2:45 p.m. EDT. Otakon 2026 is scheduled for July 31-August 2 at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C. The series will debut this year. The anime will run for two cours (quarters of a year).
author: ANN

title: Spy x Family Confirms Date for Its Next Major Anime Update
content: Spy x Family has announced that it’s going to have a major event for the anime later this year, and has set a date for when fans can hope to see the next major update for the franchise’s future.
author: ComicBook

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Casts Akio Ōtsuka
content: The official X/Twitter account for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) announced on Monday that Akio Ōtsuka is playing the Space Agency Bureau Director in the "A(E)liens" story.
author: ANN

title: The Simpsons Teases New Marge Voice Actor for Next Disney+ Special
content: It seems like The Simpsons is gearing up for the debut of a new voice star for Marge for its next big Disney+ special coming later this Summer. title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Unveils Exciting New Update
content: Solo Leveling is one of the most successful anime series in recent years, and its explosive popularity was only possible because fans were already familiar with the light novel and manhwa adaptation. It’s no surprise that a series with such a massive global fanbase broke all streaming records on Crunchyroll.
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Shares First Look at One of Its Final Manga Releases
content: Black Clover is gearing up for two final releases for Yuki Tabata’s original manga series, and the first look has been revealed at one of these key books hitting shelves in Japan later this Summer. Black Clover officially ended its manga run earlier this year after 11 full years of serialization.
author: ComicBook

title: Naver Webtoon, Munpia Announce Winners of 2026 Web Novel Contest
content: Naver WEBTOON and Munpia announced the 37 winners of the 2026 World's Largest Web Novel Contest on July 22. The annual competition, jointly organized by the two platforms, received more than 10,000 submissions, a roughly 35% increase from last year.
author: ANN

content: A major reboot is coming back for Season 3 later this year, and Netflix has finally set a release date for its big return.
